text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин defeats Бива Хаяхидэ in
the
spring Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite her loss, Бива Хаяхидэ is in
good spirits
after witnessing Narita
Taishin run so
wholeheartedly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is envious of the fun race
that
Нарита Таисин and Бива Хаяхидэ
shared...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the Twinkle Series is not over yet,
and they'll
have as many chances as they
want to race
together again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The BNW trio promises to once again
face off at
the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
